versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides a comprehensive solution for analyzing and optimizing AI crawler access to your website.

- Checks robots.txt, meta tags, and HTTP headers for AI crawler access rules.
- Identifies which major AI crawlers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Apple, Amazon, Meta) can or cannot access your site.
- Generates an access map and tailored recommendations for maximizing AI visibility while maintaining appropriate content control.
- Includes tiered guidance on the importance of allowing or blocking specific AI crawlers based on their impact on search visibility and content usage.
